thread.title: Apple target cut at DA Davidson on concerns of lower-than-expected iPhone demand - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple target cut at DA Davidson on concerns of lower-than-expected iPhone demand - MarketWatch
text: D.A. Davidson analyst Tom Forte cut his price target on Apple Inc. AAPL, -3.20% shares to $280 from $290 on Friday, though he maintained a buy rating on the stock and remains one of the most bullish Apple analysts. The lowered target reflects "a decrease in our near-term projections on concerns of lower-than-initially-expected iPhone unit sales." However, Forte said that many of these concerns around operating performance seem to be already reflected in Apple's stock, given that management warned of some emerging-market weakness on the last earnings call and that Apple's stock has come down nearly 18% since that earnings report in early November. He wrote that the recent selloff presents a buying opportunity. Apple shares are down 1.1% in premarket trading Friday, and they're off 24% over the past three months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.02% is down 6% in that time.
